articles.title: Defense Stocks Jump After Trump Calls for $1.5 Trillion Defense Budget
articles.mainIdea: Defense Stocks Jump After Trump Calls for $1.5 Trillion Defense Budget
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Defense Stocks Jump After Trump Calls for $1.5 Trillion Defense Budget. U.S. defense companies rallied premarket after President Trump called for a $1.5 trillion defense budget, more than $500 billion more than the Pentagon is expected to receive this fiscal year. Trump said the increased budget was necessary “especially in these very troubled and dangerous times,” in a social-media post late Wednesday. Shares of Northrop Grumman, Lockheed Martin, L3Harris Technologies and RTX jumped between 5% and 9% in premarket trading. Related tickers mentioned: LHX, LMT, NOC.
